# Element Sound Studio

> Element Sound Studio (also known as Element Culture) is a recording studio and music production studio in Elamakkara, Kochi, Kerala, India. It offers professional audio recording, mixing and mastering, vocal recording, sound engineering training, music production and hourly studio time, and it runs a live-events arm (Element Culture) hosting Open Mic nights, its "Listen" concert series, and artist masterclasses for Kochi's music and art community.

## Key facts
- Name: Element Sound Studio (alternate name: Element Culture)
- Website: https://elementkochi.com
- Address: 48/2123b, Meenakshi Kripa, Puliyat Lane, Peerandoor, Elamakkara, Kochi – 682026, Kerala, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98953 14555
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/elementsoundstudio_kochi/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ranjith-meleppat-a00a542a_elementsoundstudio-elementculture-kochi-ugcPost-7476931120618475520-7l0K/
- Studio time rate: ₹1,250 per hour

## Programs
- Vocal Training — ₹2,500, 4 classes
- Vocal Production — ₹10,000, 5 classes
- Music Production — ₹20,000, 5 classes
- Sound Engineering — ₹20,000, 5 classes
- Hindustani Classical Music — batches announced periodically
- Music Classes (general, online & offline) — all ages and skill levels
- Crochet Classes — ₹2,500, 5 classes, every Saturday
